title: Bakery and Kitchen Again
author: Coral Winterbourne
blurb: Theo Blackwood, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
